# Path Aliases and Folder Structure

#### Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code

## Path Aliases and Folder Structure

Once the project is initialized, two things happen before Chunk 1 of the Claude Code build: path aliases are configured, and the folder structure is created.

Path aliases solve the import hell problem. Without them, a component six levels deep imports from ../../../../hooks/useSpeedTest. With the @/ alias pointing to src/, the same import is @/hooks/useSpeedTest. This is readable, refactor-safe, and consistent across every file Claude Code generates.

```react
// vite.config.ts resolve: { alias: { '@': path.resolve(__dirname, './src'), } }

// tsconfig.json paths "paths": { "@/": ["./src/"] }
```

The folder structure for SpeedBlip was created before Chunk 1 ran:

```react
src/ assets/ components/ ui/ layout/ charts/ pages/ hooks/ workers/ utils/ types/ constants/ styles/
```

Creating this structure manually before Claude Code runs is intentional. When Claude Code sees an existing folder structure in the project, it respects it - it places new files where they belong instead of making its own structural decisions.
